sentences.en: Hello and welcome to this very special edition of The Rest is History.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎收看这期非常特别的《历史的余烬》。

sentences.en: It is the results moment.
sentences.zh: 到了公布结果的时刻了。

sentences.en: It is the final.
sentences.zh: 这是决赛。

sentences.en: It's the moment everybody has been talking about and waiting for.
sentences.zh: 这是大家一直在谈论和等待的时刻。

sentences.en: Obviously,
sentences.zh: 显然，

sentences.en: Tom Holland.
sentences.zh: 我是汤姆·霍兰。

sentences.en: Election's much in the news at the moment.
sentences.zh: 最近新闻里到处都是选举。

sentences.en: Some very implausible contenders, it has to be said.
sentences.zh: 必须得说，有一些候选人极其不靠谱。

sentences.en: But enough of the Conservative leadership conteSt. We're talking about The
sentences.zh: 但保守党党魁选举就说到这儿吧。我们要谈的是

sentences.en: Rest is History's Love Island, Dominic Sandbrook's Pleasure Island, as some like to call it.
sentences.zh: 《历史的余烬》版《海岛恋爱》，或者就像有些人喜欢叫的那样，多米尼克·桑德布鲁克的《极乐岛》。

sentences.en: And Tom, this was your idea.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，这主意是你想出来的。

sentences.en: Are you happy that it has gone according to plan?
sentences.zh: 对于事情完全按计划进行，你高兴吗？

sentences.en: I think it's been a great success.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一场巨大的成功。

sentences.en: And I think it's distracted the attention of the public from all the carnage and horror that's going on in the world.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得它分散了公众对世界上正在发生的所有血腥与恐怖事件的注意力。

sentences.en: But as you say, enough of the
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，

sentences.en: Tory leadership conteSt. Let's get on to the real conteSt. So Dominic, what did you make of it?
sentences.zh: 保守党党魁选举就到此为止。我们来谈谈真正的竞赛吧。那么，多米尼克，你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: Because you were much more sceptical than me.
sentences.zh: 因为你比我怀疑得多。

sentences.en: I was sceptical.
sentences.zh: 我确实持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: I'll be honest with you, Tom.
sentences.zh: 说实话，汤姆。

sentences.en: I've never seen Love Island.
sentences.zh: 我从来没看过《海岛恋爱》。

sentences.en: We discussed this in Monday's podcast when your daughter, Katie, very kindly came on to explain the rules to us.
sentences.zh: 我们在周一的播客里讨论过这个，当时你的女儿凯蒂非常友好地来给我们解释了规则。

sentences.en: Yes, who can't be with us because she's actually on holiday.
sentences.zh: 是的，她今天没能和我们在一起，因为她去度假了。

sentences.en: She's on a Love Island of her own, Tom.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，她正在过着她自己的“海岛恋爱”生活。

sentences.en: Very, very Love Island.
sentences.zh: 非常非常的“海岛恋爱”。

sentences.en: Yeah, she is.
sentences.zh: 对，她确实是。

sentences.en: So sorry about that.
sentences.zh: 所以对此非常抱歉。

sentences.en: But we will try and hold the thought for her.
sentences.zh: 但我们会试着替她留着这份念想。

sentences.en: So thinking back to the early rounds, I think a couple of big disappointments for me.
sentences.zh: 回想初赛的时候，我觉得有几个让我相当失望的地方。

sentences.en: I was sorry to see Virginia Woolf not have a greater impact on the competition.
sentences.zh: 我很遗憾看到弗吉尼亚·伍尔芙没能在比赛中产生更大的影响力。

sentences.en: As one of our listeners pointed out, she was famously likened to a horse looking in at a window.
sentences.zh: 正如我们的一位听众所指出的，她曾被著名地比作一匹向窗内张望的马。

sentences.en: So maybe she wasn't really cut out for Casa Amor from the start.
sentences.zh: 所以也许她从一开始就不太适合“爱情别墅”。

sentences.en: There was a very sweet comment from Lucy on Twitter talking about Katie that she loved Katie
sentences.zh: 推特上有一条露西发来的非常贴心的评论，谈到了凯蒂，她说她很喜欢凯蒂

sentences.en: musing that Virginia Woolf probably wouldn't be a strong contender for breaking up the beautiful relationship between Lady Falkander and Judas Iscariot.
sentences.zh: 的遐想，即弗吉尼亚·伍尔芙大概不会是一个强有力的竞争者，无法打破福肯德夫人和加略人犹大之间美好的关系。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, this brings me to the other big issue.
sentences.zh: 是的，好吧，这就引出了另一个重大问题。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of chats on Twitter about Judas and the fact that Judas bowed out quite early, really, by his standards, because normally he
sentences.zh: 推特上有很多关于犹大的讨论，事实上，按他的标准来看，犹大退场其实相当早，因为通常他

sentences.en: goes right to the bitter end, doesn't he?
sentences.zh: 会坚持到最后一刻，对吧？

sentences.en: No, he bowed out early in the Bible.
sentences.zh: 不，他在《圣经》里就退场很早。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, he's the first disciple to go, to be honeSt. So I think he's actually continuing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，说实话，他是第一个出局的门徒。所以我认为他其实是在延续这一传统。

sentences.en: He walks rather than is evicted.
sentences.zh: 他是自己退出的，而不是被淘汰的。

sentences.en: I mean, he's not evicted by a public vote.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他不是通过公众投票被淘汰的。

sentences.en: But anyway, yes, I mean, as I said last time, I was very keen to see how Judas would get on
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，是的，正如我上次所说，我很想看看犹出会表现得怎么样

sentences.en: because we knew what he would do for 30 pieces of silver, but we didn't know what he'd do for 50 grand.
sentences.zh: 因为我们知道他为了30块银币会做出什么事，但我们不知道他为了5万英镑会怎么做。

sentences.en: But the world would never have got to find out because he and Lady Falkander,
sentences.zh: 但世人永远不会知道了，因为他和福肯德夫人——

sentences.en: Marcia Williams, as was, they bowed out.
sentences.zh: 即以前的玛西亚·威廉姆斯——他们退出了。

sentences.en: She's obviously written some very bitter things in the newspapers on her lavender or indeed lilac notepaper.
sentences.zh: 她显然在报纸上用她的薰衣草色或丁香色信纸写了一些非常尖酸刻薄的东西。

sentences.en: Judas has kept his own counsel.
sentences.zh: 犹大则守口如瓶。

sentences.en: Wonderful.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Tom, but Tom, I mean, you had, who did you, who did you really want?
sentences.zh: 汤姆，但是汤姆，我是说，你当时有，你到底最想让谁……

sentences.en: You wanted Lord
sentences.zh: 你希望拜伦勋爵

sentences.en: Byron to win, didn't you?
sentences.zh: 赢，对吧？

sentences.en: I did want Lord Byron to win.
sentences.zh: 我确实希望拜伦勋爵赢。

sentences.en: Yes, I did.
sentences.zh: 没错，我是这么想的。

sentences.en: But do you know, Dominic, I've actually found myself after listening to that episode with a very, very soft spot, less, less for Stanley Baldwin than for his wife, Lucy.
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗，多米尼克，听完那一期节目后，我发现自己对斯坦利·鲍德温的妻子露西，而不是斯坦利·鲍德温本人，产生了一种非常非常柔软的好感。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: Because of the cricket.
sentences.zh: 因为板球。

sentences.en: Because of the cricket.
sentences.zh: 因为板球。

sentences.en: But also, apparently, I learned from Alexander Glasgow, anti-General
sentences.zh: 而且，显然，我是从亚历山大·格拉斯哥（反通用

sentences.en: Wundwort WC, again on Twitter, that she championed midwifery for those from areas of high indices of socio-economical deprivation.
sentences.zh: Wundwort WC，同样在推特上）那里得知，她大力倡导为社会经济剥夺指数较高地区的居民提供助产服务。

sentences.en: And she has a maternity hospital named after her in Stourport.
sentences.zh: 她在斯托尔波特有一家以她的名字命名的妇产医院。

sentences.en: Well, that's the Baldwin.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是鲍德温。

sentences.en: I didn't know that, but that's the, doesn't surprise me, that's the
sentences.zh: 我以前不知道，但这，这并不让我意外，这就是

sentences.en: Baldwin's for you, Tom.
sentences.zh: 鲍德温一家的作风，汤姆。

sentences.en: So, you know, I like a woman who's into midwifery and cricket.
sentences.zh: 所以呢，我喜欢一个热爱助产和板球的女性。

sentences.en: You do.
sentences.zh: 你是这样的。

sentences.en: You'd be great friends with the Baldwin's if they were alive now, wouldn't you?
sentences.zh: 如果鲍德温夫妇现在还活着，你们一定会成为好朋友，对吧？

sentences.en: You'd be, as couples, you'd be great pals with the Baldwin's.
sentences.zh: 作为夫妻，你们和鲍德温夫妇一定会成为好拍档。

sentences.en: And so I worry about what the impact of Stanley going to Dominic Sandbrook's Pleasure Island may have on Lucy.
sentences.zh: 所以我担心斯坦利去多米尼克·桑德布鲁克的极乐岛会对露西产生什么影响。

sentences.en: Well, that's true.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这倒也是。

sentences.zh: 对于感兴趣的人来说，YouTube上有一段非常精彩的视频片段，记录了斯坦利和露西·鲍德温访问退休演员之家的情景。

sentences.en: And you can sort of hear
sentences.zh: 你能听到

sentences.en: the sound of them being introduced to all these actors.
sentences.zh: 他们被介绍给所有这些演员时的声音。

sentences.en: And they're just, hello, ha, ha, ha, ha.

sentences.en: They're just constantly.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在这样。

sentences.en: They're so jolly.
sentences.zh: 他们太随和了。

sentences.en: They are so jolly that it's impossible not to take to them.
sentences.zh: 他们是如此随和，以至于让人不由自主地喜欢上他们。

sentences.en: They'd be tremendous company.
sentences.zh: 跟他们在一起会非常开心。

sentences.en: So Lucy's jolly too.
sentences.zh: 所以露西也很随和。

sentences.en: So how do you think she would get on with Theodora?
sentences.zh: 那你觉得她会怎么和狄奥多拉相处呢？

sentences.en: I think she's, Mrs. Baldwin, I think, that's hard to say because Theodora's not massively into cricket or midwifery or sort of talking about 1920s conservative politics.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她——鲍德温太太，我觉得，这很难说，因为狄奥多拉并不是特别热衷于板球或助产，或者说谈论20世纪20年代的保守党政治。

sentences.en: So I think that's difficult.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这有点困难。

sentences.en: I think the Baldwins were quite live and let live.
sentences.zh: 我觉得鲍德温夫妇相当开明。

sentences.en: I mean, as we said last time, their son Oliver was not only a Labour MP, but was gay.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如我们上次所说，他们的儿子奥利弗不仅是一名工党议员，而且是个同性恋。

sentences.en: So by the standards of sort of Stanley Baldwin's set,
sentences.zh: 所以以斯坦利·鲍德温那个圈子的标准来看，

sentences.en: Oliver was leading quite an unconventional life, but they were pretty supportive of him.
sentences.zh: 奥利弗过着一种相当离经叛道的生活，但他们相当支持他。

sentences.en: So I think Theodora, okay, she's had a checkered history.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得狄奥多拉，好吧，她有着一段坎坷的历史。

sentences.en: I think Lucy would,
sentences.zh: 我想露西会，

sentences.en: she understands the nature of Love Island.
sentences.zh: 她理解“海岛恋爱”的本质。

sentences.en: She's a woman of the world.
sentences.zh: 她是个见过世面的女人。

sentences.en: So she knows that Stanley has to get involved with Theodora.
sentences.zh: 所以她知道斯坦利不得不和狄奥多拉扯上关系。

sentences.en: But I mean, Tom, I can't believe the podcast has degenerated to me speculating about Lucy Baldwin's reaction to her husband.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，汤姆，我简直不敢相信播客竟然沦落到让我来猜测露西·鲍德温对她丈夫的反应。

sentences.en: When you did your doctorate, did you ever imagine that this is where a career in history would lead you?
sentences.zh: 当你攻读博士学位时，你可曾想象过历史学领域的职业生涯会把你带到这里？

sentences.en: I could only dream.
sentences.zh: 我做梦也没想到。

sentences.en: I could only dream.
sentences.zh: 我做梦也没想到。

sentences.en: So there were a couple of people I noticed because I did glance at the reaction, although I'm on holiday, but I glanced at the reaction.
sentences.zh: 所以我注意到有几个人——因为我确实扫了一眼大家的反应，虽然我在度假，但我还是扫了一眼。

sentences.en: Clearly, a lot of people liked the episode, but there were a couple of people who were kind of, what?

sentences.en: And pure old tosh, I believe was the phrase that was.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，当时的评语是纯粹的废话。

sentences.en: Pure old, well, it's better than woke tosh because we've had woke tosh in the past, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 纯粹的废话，嗯，总比“觉醒派废话”要好，因为我们过去也听过“觉醒派废话”，对吧？

sentences.en: So I think we, tosh is kind of our thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得我们，说废话算是我们的招牌风格了。

sentences.en: But we're, we're, we're branching out at the, as we've done more than 200 episodes, we're trying to try out different kinds of tosh.
sentences.zh: 但我们正在，我们正在，我们正在开拓新领域，既然我们已经做了200多期节目，我们正试图尝试不同类型的废话。

sentences.en: I think it's probably the best way of.
sentences.zh: 我想这大概是最好的方式……

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, as you said, you're on holiday, so you don't know who has won.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，你在度假，所以你不知道谁赢了。

sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我今天早上醒来，我儿子对我说，投票结果怎么样？

sentences.en: So we've been swimming in the Baltic, Tom, would you believe?
sentences.zh: 汤姆，你敢信，我们在波罗的海里游泳了？

sentences.zh: 我们今天早上在波罗的海里游泳了。

sentences.en: Is the Baltic not very cold, Dominic?
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，波罗的海不是很冷吗？

sentences.en: Incredibly cold.
sentences.zh: 冷得难以置信。

sentences.en: It was very, it was a very, very manly thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常非常爷们儿的事。

sentences.en: And we, as we came back, he said, oh, we forgot to check out the vote.
sentences.zh: 当我们回来的时候，他说，哦，我们忘了查一下投票结果了。

sentences.en: And I said, do you mean, and I thought for a moment, I thought, because we've been talking
sentences.zh: 我说，你是说——我脑子里闪过一个念头，因为我们昨晚一直在讨论

sentences.zh: 保守党党魁选举的事，我还以为他说的是那个，但显然他不是。

sentences.en: He wanted to know.
sentences.zh: 他想知道的是……

sentences.en: He said, did Stanley Baldwin win?
sentences.zh: 他说，斯坦利·鲍德温赢了吗？

sentences.en: Well, let's find out.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们来揭晓答案。

sentences.en: So this is for
sentences.zh: 所以这是给

sentences.en: Arthur and for everyone who hasn't heard the results.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟以及所有还没听到结果的人准备的。

sentences.zh: 有四对组合，

sentences.en: Lord Byron and Sporus, Stanley Baldwin and Theodora, General Custer and Lola Montez, and President Jimmy Carter and Olympias, the mother of Alexander the Great.
sentences.zh: 拜伦勋爵与斯波鲁斯，斯坦利·鲍德温与狄奥多拉，卡斯特将军与洛拉·蒙特斯，以及前总统吉米·卡特与亚历山大大帝的母亲奥林匹亚丝。

sentences.zh: 这是一对很不寻常的组合，对吧？

sentences.zh: 卡特和奥林匹亚丝。

sentences.en: Very unusual.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我实在看不出这能有什么好结果。

sentences.zh: 我想这也是为什么他们以14.3%的得票率名列第四。

sentences.en: Still 14%.

sentences.zh: 罗纳德·里根时获得的票数差不多了。

sentences.en: I mean, I thought that Jimmy came out of it very well.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得吉米在节目里的表现相当不错。

sentences.en: There's been a lot of interest
sentences.zh: 大家对

sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 然后，让我非常失望的是，拜伦勋爵和斯波鲁斯以16.4%的得票率名列第三。

sentences.en: They're a very glamorous couple.
sentences.zh: 他们是一对非常迷人的伴侣。

sentences.en: So what held them back?
sentences.zh: 那是什么阻碍了他们呢？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Byron was the first to be mentioned.
sentences.zh: 拜伦是第一个被提及的。

sentences.en: So perhaps people just forgot about him.
sentences.zh: 所以也许人们只是把他忘了。

sentences.en: No one forgets about Lord Byron.
sentences.zh: 没人会忘记拜伦勋爵。

sentences.en: So Sporus is the only one on that who was not one of the original 10.
sentences.zh: 所以斯波鲁斯是其中唯一一个不是最初10人之一的人。

sentences.en: So perhaps we didn't give him or her...
sentences.zh: 所以也许我们没有给他或她……

sentences.en: I don't actually know what pronouns you should use for Sporus.
sentences.zh: 我其实不知道你应该对斯波鲁斯使用什么代词。

sentences.en: Do you think that's an issue?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是个问题吗？

sentences.en: Do you think that's a gender-critical community?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是一个性别批评社群吗？

sentences.en: Kathleen Stock has been whipping people up not to vote for Sporus.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·斯托克一直在煽动大家不要投斯波鲁斯的票。

sentences.en: Is that what you think?
sentences.zh: 你是这么想的吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I think he's a more ambivalent figure, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 我觉得他是一个更具矛盾色彩的人物，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because he didn't have a choice.
sentences.zh: 因为他别无选择。

sentences.en: I think Lord Byron, I think there's a bit of...
sentences.zh: 我觉得拜伦勋爵，我觉得有点……

sentences.en: He's not very progressive, is he, Lord Byron, let's be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 他可不太开明，对吧，拜伦勋爵，老实说。

sentences.en: In some ways he is.
sentences.zh: 从某些方面来说是的。

sentences.en: He's quite cancel-worthy.
sentences.zh: 他挺招人取消的。

sentences.en: He did die for freedom.
sentences.zh: 他确实为自由而死。

sentences.en: I suppose so.
sentences.zh: 我想是吧。

sentences.en: But in other ways, perhaps not.
sentences.zh: 但从其他方面来看，也许并非如此。

sentences.en: The whole falling on chambermaids like a thunderbolt.
sentences.zh: 那种像晴天霹雳一样扑向女佣的作风。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: The whole incest thing.
sentences.zh: 还有那整档乱伦的事。

sentences.en: I mean, I think quite a lot of the things that made Byron an incendiary and controversial figure in the Regency period have now come back into focus.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得让拜伦在摄政时期成为一个煽动性和争议性人物的很多事情，现在又重新成为焦点了。

sentences.en: Yeah, in a different way.
sentences.zh: 对，以一种不同的方式。

sentences.en: Well, I definitely thought...
sentences.zh: 嗯，我绝对以为……

sentences.en: I thought Byron and Sporus would probably win, to be brutally honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说句大实话，我以为拜伦和斯波鲁斯可能会赢。

sentences.en: I thought you would be inciting people on Twitter to vote for them.
sentences.zh: 我还以为你会去推特上煽动大家投票给他们呢。

sentences.en: But you were quite restrained, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得你相当克制。

sentences.en: Partly it's because I found myself with an unexpected soft spot for Stanley Baldwin.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是我发现自己对斯坦利·鲍德温有一种意料之外的喜爱。

sentences.en: But also it's because I was busy finishing a chapter yesterday, so I didn't really have time.
sentences.zh: 但也是因为我昨天忙着赶完一章，所以实在没时间。

sentences.en: You're still deep into Parthia?
sentences.zh: 你还在深入研究帕提亚吗？

sentences.en: I've almoSt...
sentences.zh: 我都快……

sentences.en: I've got a paragraph to go.
sentences.zh: 就剩一段了。

sentences.en: Oh, so exciting.
sentences.zh: 哦，太激动人心了。

sentences.en: It's more exciting...
sentences.zh: 这比……

sentences.en: It's even more exciting than Love Island.
sentences.zh: 这比《爱情岛》还要激动人心。

sentences.en: Can you finish your Parthian chapter by the end of the day?
sentences.zh: 你能在今天结束前写完你的帕提亚那一章吗？

sentences.en: I will.
sentences.zh: 我会的。

sentences.en: I will.
sentences.zh: 我会的。

sentences.en: Trajan is going to reach the Persian Gulf and he will see a ship leaving for India.
sentences.zh: 图拉真将抵达波斯湾，他会看到一艘开往印度的船。

sentences.en: And that will be the end of the chapter.
sentences.zh: 那一章就到此结束了。

sentences.en: Anyway, but we're not talking about that.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，我们不聊这个。

sentences.en: So coming in second, General Custer and Lola Montez, 22.3%.
sentences.zh: 接下来排名第二的是，吉姆·卡斯特将军和洛拉·蒙特兹，得票率22.3%。

sentences.en: I thought they were a glamorous couple as well.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得他们是一对很有魅力的伴侣。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's a good result for Custer, who I think, Tom, you massively overpraised.
sentences.zh: 这对卡斯特来说是个好成绩，汤姆，我觉得你对他的评价未免太高了。

sentences.en: Just quite...
sentences.zh: 简直……

sentences.en: I mean, you described him at the beginning as a great general, when he's famously one of the worst generals in human history.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你一开始把他描述为一位伟大的将军，而他众所周知是人类历史上最糟糕的将军之一。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, his career didn't have the ideal conclusion.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他的职业生涯并没有迎来理想的结局。

sentences.en: Well, he did die laughing, to be fair.
sentences.zh: 不过说句公道话，他确实是笑着死去的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's good to die with a smile on your lips.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，嘴角带着微笑死去挺好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And from the point of view of Love Island, that's what matters.
sentences.zh: 从《爱情岛》的角度来看，这才是最重要的。

sentences.en: A smile on your lips.
sentences.zh: 嘴角带着微笑。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: A toss of your ringlets.
sentences.zh: 卷发一甩。

sentences.en: Banter in your heart.
sentences.zh: 心中充满风趣幽默。

sentences.en: Banter in your heart.
sentences.zh: 心中充满风趣幽默。

sentences.en: And I think that Lola would provide him with great synergy.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为洛拉会与他产生极大的协同效应。

sentences.en: I think people responded to that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得人们对这一点产生了共鸣。

sentences.en: But coming in, I mean, a thumping majority, 47%, so almost half the vote, Stanley Baldwin and Theodora.
sentences.zh: 但是排在前面的，我是说，以压倒性的多数，47%，也就是将近一半的选票，斯坦利·鲍德温和狄奥多拉。

sentences.en: And Dominic, a comment from Mitchell Dryden, who says, I think it's my favourite podcast ever.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，米切尔·德赖登有一条评论，他说，我觉得这是我最喜欢的播客。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I laughed so hard at the image of Stanley Baldwin and Theodora, it was as if you were reading the intimate and private thought journal of you, Dominic.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利·鲍德温和狄奥多拉的画面让我笑得前仰后合，就好像你在朗读你自己的私密内心日记一样，多米尼克。

sentences.en: Oh, that's...
sentences.zh: 哦，那是……

sentences.en: So, there you go.
sentences.zh: 所以，就是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's my dream.
sentences.zh: 对，那是我的梦想。

sentences.en: Stanley Baldwin and Theodora at the Molyneux, watching Wolves win, you know, qualify for the Champions League final.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利·鲍德温和狄奥多拉在莫利纽球场，看着狼队取胜，你知道的，获得欧冠决赛资格。

sentences.en: So, you've always been a big fan of Theodora, haven't you?
sentences.zh: 所以，你一直都是狄奥多拉的超级粉丝，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, I did, we, I think, Tom, we should do, give Theodora more, do her more justice.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我确实，我们，汤姆，我觉得我们应该，给狄奥多拉更多，更多地还原她的公正。

sentences.en: So, I think in a few weeks, we should do an episode about Justinian and Theodora, because it's such a fascinating...
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得过几个星期，我们应该做一期关于查士丁尼和狄奥多拉的节目，因为这太引人入胜了……

sentences.en: They're one of the great power couples.
sentences.zh: 他们是最伟大的权力夫妻之一。

sentences.en: Many years ago, I did a undergraduate course about the Near East in the age of Justinian and Muhammad, which would appeal to you.
sentences.zh: 很多年前，我上过一门关于查士丁尼和穆罕默德时代的近东的本科课程，这会吸引你的。

sentences.en: And, of course, the reign of Justinian is this great sort of hinge moment, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 当然，查士丁尼的统治是一个伟大的转折点，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's the kind of beginning of late antiquity, I suppose, or it's the sort of the early stages of late antiquity.
sentences.zh: 我想这可以说是晚期古代的开端，或者可以说是晚期古代的早期阶段。

sentences.en: It's one of those points that people sometimes say is when the Roman Empire becomes the Byzantine world.
sentences.zh: 这是人们有时所说的罗马帝国转变为拜拜廷世界的节点之一。

sentences.en: He's the last Latin-speaking emperor.
sentences.zh: 他是最后一位说拉丁语的皇帝。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: And he tries his reconquest of Italy and so on and North Africa.
sentences.zh: 他试图重新征服意大利等等以及北非。

sentences.en: And Theodora is this fantastic character.
sentences.zh: 而狄奥多拉是一个极其出彩的人物。

sentences.en: I mean, because of Procopius' secret history that we talked about last time, we know a fair bit about her.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，因为我们上次谈到的普罗科匹乌斯的《秘史》，我们对她了解颇多。

sentences.en: But what we know is so clearly kind of tabloid gossip, incredibly salacious gossip.
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的显然是那种小报八卦，极其耸人听闻的八卦。

sentences.en: Well, except there's also her geography.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不过她还有她的地理。

sentences.en: As you pointed out, she became a saint.
sentences.zh: 正如你所指出的，她成了一位圣人。

sentences.en: Never really gets emphasised.
sentences.zh: 从不怎么被强调。

sentences.en: But you were right.
sentences.zh: 但你是对的。

sentences.en: We must do a special on her.
sentences.zh: 我们必须做一期关于她的特别节目。

sentences.en: So, let's do that.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们就这么办吧。

sentences.en: Well, let's do that when you get back from the holiday.
sentences.zh: 嗯，等你度假回来我们就做这个。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 一定的。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 一定的。

sentences.en: Because we're overdue.
sentences.zh: 因为我们早就该做了。

sentences.en: We've done the American Civil War.
sentences.zh: 我们讲过美国内战。

sentences.en: We've done quite a lot of modern stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们讲过很多现代的内容。

sentences.en: A bit of 6th century.
sentences.zh: 还有一点六世纪的。

sentences.en: Well, we haven't really done Byzantium.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们还没有真正讲过拜占庭。

sentences.en: We haven't done an episode exclusively on Byzantium, have we?
sentences.zh: 我们还没有做过一期完全专门讲拜占庭的节目，对吧？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: And we get to talk about the Hagia Sophia, Tom.
sentences.zh: 而且我们可以聊聊圣索菲亚大教堂，汤姆。

sentences.en: And you can talk about – and at the end, I mean, the great question with Justinian and Theodora –
sentences.zh: 你可以聊聊——最后，我是说，关于查士丁尼和狄奥多拉的巨大疑问——

sentences.en: I don't want to get into doing the podcast right now, but the great question is whether their reign lays the foundations for the rise of Islam later on,
sentences.zh: 我现在可不想开始录播客，但最大的问题是他们的统治是否为后来伊斯兰教的崛起奠定了基础，

sentences.en: and the collapse of a lot of the Eastern Roman world because of overextension.
sentences.zh: 以及由于战线拉得太长而导致的整个东罗马世界的崩溃。

sentences.en: And listeners will be able to find out our views on that in a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 听众们将在几周后了解我们对此的看法。

sentences.en: Well, I think there's something else that happens in Justinian's reign that may be more of a contributory factor, but we will discuss that when we come to record it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为查士丁尼统治时期还发生了另一件事，可能才是更重要的促成因素，但等我们来录制时再讨论。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, Dominic, I mustn't keep you from your holiday.
sentences.zh: 好了，多米尼克，我可不能耽误你度假。

sentences.en: No, Tom, you absolutely mustn't.
sentences.zh: 不，汤姆，你绝对不能。

sentences.en: I have to go and get Trajan to the Persian Gulf.
sentences.zh: 我还得去把图拉真送到波斯湾呢。

sentences.en: So we will end it there.
sentences.zh: 所以我们就聊到这里吧。

sentences.en: What a triumph for Stanley Baldwin, though, Tom.
sentences.zh: 不过，对斯坦利·鲍德温来说，这是多么巨大的胜利啊，汤姆。

sentences.en: I think it's fair.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很公平。

sentences.en: Yes, a huge triumph.
sentences.zh: 是的，巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: You must be – I'm sure it'll set you up for your holiday perfectly.
sentences.zh: 你一定——我确信这会让你的假期有一个完美的开端。

sentences.en: I've got a spring in my step now.
sentences.zh: 我现在走路都带风了。

sentences.en: Many thanks to those of you who enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢喜欢这个节目的朋友们。

sentences.en: Huge apologies to those of you who didn't.
sentences.zh: 向不喜欢的朋友们深表歉意。

sentences.en: That is the most insincere apology I think I've ever heard because, Tom, you loved every minute of that.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是我听过最假惺惺的道歉，因为，汤姆，你乐在其中。

sentences.en: You're not sorry at all.
sentences.zh: 你一点也不觉得抱歉。

sentences.en: No, I'm not sorry at all.
sentences.zh: 不，我一点也不觉得抱歉。

sentences.en: And I'd do it again, but probably not for a while.
sentences.zh: 而且我还会再做一次，不过可能不会太快。

sentences.en: Well, maybe next year.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许明年吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it should be a regular feature.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得这应该成为一个常规栏目。

sentences.en: Yes, I think it should.
sentences.zh: 对，我也这么觉得。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thanks ever so much for listening, everyone.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: And we will – well, we're back on – we're back tomorrow on Thursday with the most – someone that you absolutely cannot imagine being on Love Island, George Orwell.
sentences.zh: 我们将会——嗯，我们明天周四回归，带来一位你绝对无法想象会出现在《爱情岛》上的人，乔治·奥威尔。

sentences.en: So we'll see you then.
sentences.zh: 那我们到时见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.zh: 感谢收听《历史的余烬》。
